services.title: Services
services.intro:
I build web apps end to end:
APIs, databases and the
interfaces on top of them.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Web Applications
fullstack.subtitle: Next.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL
fullstack.description: End-to-end products from database schema to UI: NestJS backends, Prisma and PostgreSQL, React and Next.js frontends, and payment integration with Paddle or Stripe, as in 3ssay and Jeff.

backend.title: Backend & REST APIs
backend.subtitle: Node.js, NestJS and Express
backend.description: Backend services and RESTful APIs with clean, maintainable business logic, JWT-based authentication and authorization, and third-party integrations.

databases.title: Databases & Data Modeling
databases.subtitle: PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis
databases.description: Relational and NoSQL schema design, data access layers with Prisma and TypeORM, and query and data model optimization.

frontend.title: Frontend & Mobile
frontend.subtitle: React, Next.js, Angular and Ionic
frontend.description: Responsive interfaces and reusable components with React, Next.js, Angular and Svelte, plus cross-platform mobile apps with Ionic. TanStack Query, React Hook Form and Zod for data and forms.

devops.title: DevOps & Deployment
devops.subtitle: Docker, GitHub Actions and Azure
devops.description: Containerized apps with Docker and Docker Compose, CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, and deployments on Azure, with AWS S3 and Firebase where needed.

animation.title: Animation & Interactive 3D
animation.subtitle: GSAP and Three.js
animation.description: Smooth scroll-driven animations and interactive 3D scenes that make a site feel alive, without hurting performance. Used on Morninx.

work.title: Work
work.intro:
Selected projects and
where I've built them.

microsol.summary: Backend services and REST APIs with NestJS and TypeScript, database schemas and data access layers with Prisma and PostgreSQL. Production frontends in React and Next.js with TanStack Query, React Hook Form and Zod, plus GSAP and Three.js experiences.

togetech.summary: Led a team delivering full-stack web and mobile apps with React, Angular, Ionic and NestJS. Designed REST APIs with JWT authentication and authorization, and PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases with TypeORM.

shi.summary: Full-stack web apps for clients with React, Next.js and NestJS: backend services, REST APIs, JWT authentication and authorization, and reusable frontend components.

prepare.summary: Full-stack product features with React, Svelte and TypeScript: API integrations, authentication flows and third-party integrations. Contributed to Docker, Azure and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.

sabah.summary: Apartment Management startup product: accessible, optimized interfaces with React, Redux, TypeScript and SASS, built together with UI/UX designers and backend developers.
